supporting_observations.claim: The supplied records do not include a direct account-creation or account-change event for sysops. The domain-controller records shown include Kerberos events for the WS-RDIAZ-01$ computer account, not evidence identifying who created sysops.
WS-RDIAZ-01 made LDAP connections to the domain controller during the review window, but these connection records do not expose the LDAP operations or establish that an account was created.
The available evidence is insufficient to determine whether the alerted sysops account was created, who initiated any creation, or whether the activity was authorized.

known_telemetry_limitations: The provided records are primarily network, proxy, and connection telemetry; they do not include the relevant domain-controller account-management audit events or directory-change details.
The LDAP records report connections and byte counts but not the LDAP requests, target objects, or changes.
The supplied evidence does not include process execution or logon attribution sufficient to connect the LDAP activity to an account-creation action.
claims_not_established: Whether sysops was actually created at or around 13:42 UTC.
Which user, host, process, or credential—if any—created sysops.
Whether sysops was added to any group or granted privileges.
Whether the activity was authorized or malicious.
additional_evidence_needed: Domain-controller Security events for the review window, especially account creation and modification events (such as 4720, 4738, and relevant group-membership events), with subject, target, and logon details.
Directory Service change auditing or equivalent AD change records identifying the object and attributes changed.
Endpoint process-creation and logon telemetry for the suspected source host and account, correlated with the exact creation timestamp.
Current and historical sysops account properties, group memberships, creation metadata, and any change-ticket or help-desk request authorizing it.
unrelated_findings: WS-RDIAZ-01 contacted desktop.dropbox.com with a Dropbox updater user agent; Dropbox is not listed as approved. This does not establish any connection to the sysops alert. (T277-00068, T277-00069)

WS-RDIAZ-01 attempted a connection to clients4.google.com with a GoogleDriveFS user agent, but the proxy returned status 407 (authentication required); Google Drive is not listed as approved. This does not establish a successful connection or relate to the sysops alert. (T277-00231, T277-00232)

WS-RDIAZ-01 queried a randomly formatted a1b2c3d4e5.cloudfront.net name; the supplied DNS record alone does not establish what generated the query or whether it was malicious. This is separate from the sysops alert. (T277-00043, T277-00044)
